footprint_audit.method: Compared every footprint assignment in both .kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb files against LCSC/JLCPCB package data, EasyEDA canonical footprints (pad-level geometry via EasyEDA API), Hongli datasheet recommended land pattern, and KiCad 10 library pad geometry. PCBs contain no nets yet (placement-only), so footprint fixes are safe.

verified_ok.jlc_parts:LED-SMD_3P-L3.5-W3.5_NLW3535AV: Pad-for-pad identical to EasyEDA footprint for C5445086; matches Hongli recommended pads (outer 0.5x3.3 vs 0.51x3.32, center 1.4x3.3 vs 1.3x3.17, gap 0.45 vs 0.40). 3-pad SMD3535-3P confirmed. Center pad 3 = thermal (TS/cathode point); tie to cathode copper for cooling per datasheet.
verified_ok.jlc_parts:SOT-89-5 (96x PT4115): Identical to EasyEDA footprint for C347356; PT4115 package confirmed SOT-89-5.
verified_ok.jlc_parts:SOIC-24_L15.4-W7.5 (6x CD74HC4: Identical to EasyEDA footprint for C496123 (SOIC-24 wide, 1.27mm pitch, LS10.3).
verified_ok.jlc_parts:SW-SMD_4P-L5.1-W5.1 (3x TS-118: Identical to EasyEDA footprint for C318884 (pads 1.0x0.75 at x=+-3.0, y=+-1.85).
verified_ok.Package_SO:TSSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm (ADS111: ADS1115IDGSR is VSSOP-10 (DGS) 3x3 P0.5 - same JEDEC MO-187 land pattern; compatible.
verified_ok.Inductor_SMD:L_Sunlord_SWPA4030S / SWPA6: KiCad official Sunlord series footprints, exact series match for C54731 / C36414.
verified_ok.Capacitor_SMD:CP_Elec_8x10 (100uF 50V C1: Both replacement parts are D8xL10mm - matches.
verified_ok.Capacitor_SMD:CP_Elec_6.3x7.7 (220uF 16V: Replacement part is D6.3xL5.8mm; pad pattern is diameter-driven (6.3mm) - matches (height irrelevant to land pattern).
verified_ok.R_0603/R_0805/C_0603/C_0805/LED_0805: All chip parts confirmed correct imperial sizes (NTC C13564=0603, 0R39 C2930218=0805, 2.2uF C125847=0805, 100nF C14663=0603, LEDs 0805).
verified_ok.Connector_BarrelJack:BarrelJack_Horizont: EasyEDA footprint for C381115: 3 slotted pads, 6.0mm pin spacing, third pin at midpoint offset 4.7mm - identical triangle to KiCad footprint (0,0)/(6,0)/(3,4.7) with 1x3mm slots. Fits.
verified_ok.IDC-Header_2x25_P2.54mm_Vertical (C9044): C9044 is the straight/vertical 2x25 box header - matches.
verified_ok.PinHeader_1x02 (C2337 breakaway), PinSoc: Straight 2.54mm parts on straight 2.54mm footprints - match.

issues_found.IDC 2x10 (J-logic, both boards): Footprint was Vertical while BOM part C9144 is RIGHT-ANGLE. Resolved in scripts/design_data.py (idc20 -> IDC-Header_2x10_P2.54mm_Horizontal, keeping C9144); generated .kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb still show Vertical until the next regeneration run.
issues_found.KF301-5.0-2P terminal (control board): FIXED. Was TerminalBlock_MaiXu_MX126-5.0-02P (drill 1.3mm); JLCPCB/EasyEDA recommended footprint for C474881 uses 1.4mm holes and KF301 rectangular blade pins are a marginal fit in 1.3mm. Created jlc_parts:TerminalBlock_KF301-5.0-2P_1x02_P5.00mm (MX126 geometry, drills enlarged to 1.4mm, pads 2.8mm, pitch 5.0mm), updated scripts/design_data.py FP[screw2] (schematics are generated from this file), and patched control-board.kicad_pcb in place. 3D model still references MX126 STEP (visually equivalent block).

footprint_audit.regeneration_note: The .kicad_sch files are generated by scripts/gen_schematics_hier.py from scripts/design_data.py. All footprint fixes were applied in design_data.py so they survive regeneration; the currently-checked-in control-board.kicad_sch still carries the old MX126 and Vertical-2x10 strings until regenerated.
